info.title: API.SH: ImmoScout24
info.description: The ImmoScout24 API from API.SH: public ImmoScout24 data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
An ImmoScout24 provider (agency, landlord or developer): id, name, focus, address, phone, fax, email, website, social links, about text, specialisations, areas served, services, opening hours, badges, award, followers, logo, overall rating, seeker and owner ratings for the last 12, 18 and 24 months and all time (average, count, recommend share and each criterion), listing counts and imprint; plus its current listings, 20 a page (id, link, type, rent or buy, price, living space, rooms, postcode, city, image). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immoscout24-agency

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A provider page (/anbieter/<name>/<id> or /anbieter/profil/<name>; `agent.profile_url` in /immoscout24/v1/listing), or the name in `name`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Provider name slug, e.g. gesobau-ag.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Listings for rent or for sale (default rent).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Residential or commercial listings (default residential).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of listings.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The listing (expose): price and costs, all attributes (rooms, floor, year built, heating, energy certificate…), description texts, photos and the agent or company. Listings are removed when let or sold; the example may expire, use an `id` from a search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immoscout24-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (or pass `url`, an immobilienscout24.de/expose/… URL).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
ImmoScout24's place suggestions for a city, district, street or postcode: id, label, type and geopath. The geopath works as `location` in /immoscout24/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immoscout24-locations

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place, street or postcode.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
ImmoScout24's price atlas for a place: price per m² by quarter for buying and renting apartments and houses (latest quarter with its low and high), the parent area's history for comparison, and the latest price of each district or sub-area with its geopath.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immoscout24-price-map

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place name (the best match is used) or a geopath from /immoscout24/v1/locations, e.g. /de/berlin/berlin.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An immobilienscout24.de/immobilienpreise/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.unit: per m² (rent: per m² per month)

get.description:
Apartments, houses, plots, garages, shared-flat rooms and commercial property (office, store, gastronomy, industry, investment) to rent or buy in a German city or district, or within a radius of a point, 20 per page, with price, living space, rooms, address, coordinates (when the advertiser shows them) and photos. Filters for price, rooms, size, year built, floor, equipment (balcony, lift, kitchen, cellar, garden, guest toilet, parking, step-free), heating, energy class, new building, pets and apartment type. `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/immoscout24-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or district name (or an ImmoScout24 geo path such as /de/berlin/berlin). Not needed when lat and lon are given.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: apartment (default), house, plot, garage, shared_flat (rent only), office, store, gastronomy, industry (these four list the type's offers whatever the transaction) or investment (buy only).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of a point in Germany to search around (with lon), instead of location.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude of that point (with lat).

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Radius around lat/lon in km, 0.5-200 (default 5).

parameters.name: min_size
parameters.description: Minimum living space in m².

parameters.name: max_size
parameters.description: Maximum living space in m².

parameters.name: min_year_built
parameters.description: Built in or after this year.

parameters.name: max_year_built
parameters.description: Built in or before this year.

parameters.name: min_floor
parameters.description: Lowest floor (0 = ground floor).

parameters.name: max_floor
parameters.description: Highest floor.

parameters.name: equipment
parameters.description: Required equipment, comma separated: balcony, lift, kitchen (built-in), cellar, garden, guest_toilet, parking, wheelchair (step-free access).

parameters.name: heating
parameters.description: Heating types, comma separated (any of): central, self_contained_central, stove.

parameters.name: energy_class
parameters.description: Energy efficiency classes, comma separated (any of): a_plus, a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h.

parameters.name: new_building
parameters.description: true for new buildings only, false to exclude them.

parameters.name: pets_allowed
parameters.description: true for offers allowing pets; negotiable also includes offers where pets are negotiable.

parameters.name: apartment_type
parameters.description: Apartment types, comma separated (any of): penthouse, maisonette, loft, terracedflat, groundfloor, roofstorey, apartment, halfbasement, raisedgroundfloor, other.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
